name: davibank.pa
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 18 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.davibank.pa scores 61 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 32 pass. Fix first: 18 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 18 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /es/banca-personal.html, /es/banca-para-pymes.html, /es/banca-corporativa.html, /es/banca-premium.html and 14 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: ARIA attributes must conform to valid values
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /es/banca-personal.html, /es/banca-para-pymes.html, /es/banca-corporativa.html, for example #header__search. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Adobe Analytics (9 requests), Google Ads (5 requests), Google Analytics (5 requests), X Ads (4 requests), Quantcast (2 requests), Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /es/banca-personal.html, /es/banca-para-pymes.html, /es/banca-corporativa.html, for example #signin-dropdown-toggle. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 20 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: 38 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 519 ms
Language alternates point at each other
